plan.title: TS migration Wave 9: full Python removal (#1860 Bucket B delete)

narratives.Description: Execute the operator-authorized Bucket B delete on #1860: remove run/, scripts/*.py, pytest suite, pyproject/uv, parity oracles, and Python CI legs; rewire release build/reconcile/roadmap to native TS; confirm task check green with zero Python on disk.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Port release build-dist to TypeScript; rewire release pipeline off python-steps.ts.
- Delete run, run.bat, run.py, scripts/, tests/ (pytest), pyproject.toml, uv.lock.
- Remove packages/cli parity harnesses and ts:parity* tasks; collapse check:framework-source to TS-only.
- Strip Python + parity jobs from .github/workflows/ci.yml; simplify windows-task-dispatch.
- Update content-contract tests and docs; CHANGELOG entry. Closes #1860.
narratives.UserStory: As a deft maintainer, I want zero Python on disk in the framework repo, so the TS migration epic (#1530) can close and consumers never depend on uv/pytest parity oracles.

items.title: Given operator sign-off on #1860, when Bucket B delete lands, then run/, scripts/, pyproject.toml, uv.lock, and the pytest tree are removed.

narrative.Acceptance: No scripts/*.py, run entrypoints, pyproject.toml, or tests/**/*.py remain in the repo.

items.title: Given the delete, when task check:framework-source runs, then it passes with TS-only gates (no uv run python, no parity harness).

narrative.Acceptance: check:framework-source exits 0; CI python and parity jobs removed.

items.title: Given release pipeline steps, when cutting a release, then roadmap refresh, lifecycle reconcile, and dist build run without Python.

narrative.Acceptance: Release pipeline uses native TS for roadmap, reconcile, and build-dist; no uv lock step.

references.title: Issue #1860: TS migration Wave 9 — full Python removal
